description: Variation of condition U0183811 (energy reduction) of planning permission 24/0568/VRC (Variation of condition U0165004 - Approved Drawings and Documents, of planning permission 23/1819/FUL), as amended by PA25/1263 (the condition to be varied to add additional plans to showing how the different phases can be constructed). Proposal to reduce target reduction on Carbon Dioxide emissions beyond Building Control regulations requirement (2021) from 35% to 10%.
decision_conditions:
We have amended description of development, please confirm you agree? 
 'Variation of condition U0183823 (approved drawings) and U0183811 (energy reduction) of planning permission 24/0568/VRC (Extension at rear to increase internal floorspace of the two second floor dwellings form 39sq.m to 52.sq.m, and form 44sq.m to 53sq.m; change of brick colour; rear facing first floor terraces; introduction of ground floor rear gate; repositioning of main front door entrance; removing courtyard windows; introduction of rooflights on main roof; raised parapet on rear ground floor roof extension). Reduce target reduction n Carbon Dioxide emissions beyond Building Control regulations requrement (2021) from 35% to 10%.'
